gen-mystery-quest-gf-alexandria: Mystery Quest has gaping jaws on every curve and compact ascenders perched over tall lowercase, a nostalgic, storybook look. Alexandria answers it with a sturdy sans-serif frame that feels modern.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-amiko: Amiko sets lowercase as tall and chunky as a crayon mark, with terminals flaring outward like tongs. Mystery Quest stands over it, bookish and old-fashioned.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-bangla: Mystery Quest wears a storybook, nostalgic face, its curves left open and its ascenders tucked in tight. Anek Bangla follows with wide, barely curled s shapes, and a modest bump in size would suit it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari has distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, a modern sans that gives nothing away. Mystery Quest, with its bookish, nostalgic jaws, brings the old-world mood beside it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-gujarati: Lowercase here nearly rivals the capitals, and the c gapes wide, so Anek Gujarati feels friendly and plain sans. Mystery Quest adds bookish nostalgia above it, and the mix stays easy going.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Wide-open and generous, Anek Gurmukhi gives every small letter a big counter and every round character an open-handed curve. Mystery Quest brings a nostalgic, bookish heading to meet it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-kannada: Mystery Quest opens with bookish, nostalgic curves, each jaw left ajar above its compact ascenders. And Anek Kannada, tall as a squared-off woodblock letter, could take a slightly smaller size.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-latin: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest its storybook, nostalgic character, with short ascenders above tall lowercase. Anek Latin holds its letters open too, so the two feel related.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-malayalam: Mystery Quest leans bookish and nostalgic, with curves left open and ascenders kept compact. Anek Malayalam sits beside it as a plain sans, barely any gap from lowercase to caps, curve tips never touching.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-odia: Mystery Quest is bookish and nostalgic, its curves left open and its ascenders held compact. And Anek Odia keeps its rounds unlatched too, so a slightly larger size would let them breathe.
